correctness.rationale: Fontanari's drives on the edge satisfy U_A+U_B=1+gamma, U_A-U_B=(1-gamma)d. Below gamma=1 each drive t lies in [0,1] and t^(1/p)>=t, so all are eligible; above gamma=1 both drives are at least one. The surplus difference is strictly decreasing in u; because there is overlap, its root never assigns a voter to an ineligible choice. Its centered equation is exactly Phi_p(d_next)=(1-gamma)d. Phi_p is odd, has positive derivative, and its second derivative is strictly positive on (0,1) for every real p>2. Oddness gives the alternating-sign identity by induction. Convexity makes the secant Phi_p(r)/r strictly increasing from c_p to 1. For s=|1-gamma|>0 the amplitude map is strictly increasing: below/above each nonzero crossing it moves toward that crossing without overshoot, and at s<=c_p it decreases any nonzero amplitude to zero. Increasing amplitudes as a map exclude any other periodic behavior; signs then distinguish fixed points from the one two-cycle. At gamma=0,2 the nonzero limiting amplitude is 1, and its one-sided multiplier is 2/p. At gamma=1 the first iterate is identically zero (the origin needs no update). The critical inverse expansion has coefficient -beta=-(p-1)(p-2)/6; positivity of the iterates permits reciprocal squaring, giving an increment 2*beta+O(r_n^2), hence the stated limit by Cesaro summation at both thresholds. All-real proof is independent of finite tests. Replay: python replay/4_cutoff.py, exact generalized-series composition and reciprocal-square check for seven rational exponents plus 108 one-step reflected equation pairs from exact rational orbits at p=3,4,5,7, and exact p=3,4 amplitude checks. The uploaded verifier was read, not executed. No claim about abstention-positive start, p=2, or gamma>2 is needed.

The sharp coefficient for every nonzero edge start, exact pairing of opposite-sign regimes and rigorous elimination of additional periodic behavior provide usable information for the originating map's phase diagram.
